en.summary: This commit fixes L1 tag-hit hold behavior so the hold queue only captures hit metadata when the downstream probe buffer is actually stalled.
why_it_counts: The patch is in active L1 tag access logic, not tests or tooling.
It corrects a one-line handshake bug on the queue that preserves tag-hit results across stalls.
Incorrect skid-buffer enqueue timing can directly replay stale hit state into later accesses.
evidence: cachehit_hold.io.enq.valid changes from probeReadBuf.valid to probeReadBuf.valid && !probeReadBuf.ready.
The hold queue feeds io.hit_st1 and io.waymaskHit_st1 in L1TagAccess.scala.
The queue is only one entry deep, so over-enqueueing stale metadata is behaviorally visible.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A skid or hold buffer in the cache tag path should capture hit metadata only when the next stage is stalled. If it records data on every valid probe, even when the consumer is ready, the buffer can preserve stale hit and way information and replay that stale state into a later request.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A tag probe produces a valid hit result while the downstream stage is ready, followed by later traffic that can observe the stale buffered metadata.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Allow the hold queue to enqueue on upstream valid alone instead of only on a real stall condition.
portability_notes: This applies to any one-entry skid buffer or replay queue that preserves cache-hit metadata across ready/valid stalls.
The bug is especially visible when the queue output has priority over fresh combinational hit results.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the tag-path hold or skid queue that captures hit metadata for replay.
Remove the downstream-not-ready term from the enqueue valid condition so enqueue depends only on upstream valid.
Leave dequeue control unchanged so the stale entry can later replay when the queue is examined.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: cachehit_hold enqueue gating in the L1 tag path
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The commit adds !probeReadBuf.ready to cachehit_hold.io.enq.valid so the hold queue only captures state on a real stall.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In L1TagAccess.scala, cachehit_hold.io.enq.valid changed from probeReadBuf.valid to probeReadBuf.valid && !probeReadBuf.ready.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: The tag path can replay stale hit and waymask metadata, causing later probe reads to be reported as hits on the wrong way or at the wrong time.
evidence_for_injection: The queue output directly influences io.hit_st1 and io.waymaskHit_st1.
The patch is a single-condition handshake fix with an immediate control-path effect.
The surrounding code already gates the buffered waymask with downstream readiness, which matches the intended stall-only behavior.
notes: This is a small and highly localized fault that is easy to reverse-patch.
It is best exercised with back-to-back tag probes or readiness toggling in the probe path.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 L1 tag-hit hold 行为，使保持队列只会在下游 probe buffer 真正阻塞时才捕获命中元数据。
why_it_counts: 补丁位于实际生效的 L1 tag access 逻辑中，而不是测试或工具代码。
它修复了一个保持 tag-hit 结果的队列握手单行错误。
如果 skid buffer 在错误时机入队，就可能把陈旧 hit 状态重放到后续访问上。
evidence: cachehit_hold.io.enq.valid 从 probeReadBuf.valid 改成了 probeReadBuf.valid && !probeReadBuf.ready。
L1TagAccess.scala 中这个 hold 队列会驱动 io.hit_st1 和 io.waymaskHit_st1。
该队列只有 1 项深度，因此错误入队的陈旧元数据会直接影响可观察行为。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: cache tag 路径中的 skid/hold buffer 只应在下一阶段阻塞时捕获命中元数据。如果它在每次 probe valid 时都记录数据，即使消费者已经 ready，也会把陈旧的 hit/way 信息保留下来，并在后续请求中错误重放。

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: tag probe 产生了有效命中结果，而且当时下游阶段是 ready，之后又有后续流量能够观察到队列里的陈旧元数据。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让 hold 队列只依赖上游 valid 入队，而不再要求真实的 stall 条件。
portability_notes: 该模式适用于任何用于跨 ready/valid 阻塞保存 cache-hit 元数据的单项 skid buffer 或 replay queue。
当队列输出优先于新鲜组合 hit 结果时，这类缺陷尤其容易显现。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到 tag 路径里用于保存 hit 元数据的 hold/skid queue。
从入队 valid 条件中去掉“下游未 ready”的项，使入队仅依赖上游 valid。
保持出队控制不变，让错误保留下来的陈旧条目在之后被重放出来。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: L1 tag 路径中 cachehit_hold 的入队门控
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该提交给 cachehit_hold.io.enq.valid 增加了 !probeReadBuf.ready，使保持队列只在真实阻塞时才保存状态。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 L1TagAccess.scala 中，cachehit_hold.io.enq.valid 从 probeReadBuf.valid 改成了 probeReadBuf.valid && !probeReadBuf.ready。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: tag 路径可能重放陈旧的 hit 和 waymask 元数据，导致后续 probe read 在错误时机或错误 way 上被报告为命中。
evidence_for_injection: 该队列输出会直接影响 io.hit_st1 和 io.waymaskHit_st1。
补丁是一个单条件握手修复，控制路径后果非常直接。
周围代码本来就根据下游 ready 对缓冲的 waymask 进行门控，这与“只在 stall 时保持”这一意图一致。
notes: 这是一个很小且局部的故障点，适合直接做 reverse patch。
最适合用 probe 路径 ready 变化或背靠背 tag probe 来触发。
